title: The Orange That Was Looked Down Upon
summary: An apple with glossy skin mocks the rough skin of the orange. But who will help it when it falls?
moral: Do not judge someone by their appearance. A good heart and a willingness to help are far more valuable.
pages: In a bright orchard, Apple, Banana, and Orange lived side by side. Every morning they basked and chatted. Apple was always proud of its red, glossy skin.
'Look at my skin, smooth and shiny!' said Apple. 'Orange's skin is rough and spotty. So ugly!' Banana giggled too. Orange lowered its head and said nothing.
Orange moved away and sat alone under the tree. 'Maybe it is true, I am not as pretty as Apple,' it whispered sadly. But it did not get angry, and kept smiling at whoever passed by.
One day Apple walked near a hole while showing off its skin to the birds. 'Look at me! Who is as pretty as I am?' Busy boasting, it did not see the path ahead.
Thud! Apple slipped and fell into the deep hole. 'Help! I cannot get out!' it cried. Its skin was too slippery to climb the earthen wall.
Banana wanted to help, but its hands were slippery and could not grip. Orange, hearing the cries, ran over at once. It reached out its rough hand, and its grip was strong so it did not slip.

With a pull from Orange, Apple managed to get out. 'Forgive me, Orange,' said Apple, ashamed. 'Your rough skin is what saved me.' Orange smiled, 'It is all right, we are friends.' From that day on they never mocked each other again. The end.
